title: Tech Pack Builder
oneLiner: Free in-browser tech pack builder for small clothing brands: style info, flat sketch upload, measurement spec table with size grading, bill of materials, construction notes and colourways, exported as a factory-ready PDF with no signup
customer: Independent and first-time apparel brands, freelance fashion designers and small private-label sellers (US, UK and India) who send tech packs to manufacturers
revenueModel: Free: one complete tech pack printed to PDF, no account. Paid tier (price to be tested in the case, monthly against one-time or per pack): saved style library, auto-grading, BOM cost roll-up, templates, share link for factories

paidPrice.product: Techpacker Techpack Builder plan, USD 35 per user per month billed yearly; AI Tech Packs Starter USD 50 a month. About Rs 3,300 a month at about 94.3 INR per USD

searches.note: seodata.dev, read 2026-11-28. Only the head buyer term is counted; tech pack templates (1,900) shares its group; tech pack (5,400) is broader and partly informational; tech pack maker and tech pack software are 90 each, so buyers search for the template, not the software. Also https://aitechpacks.com/pricing for the second paid price.

screen.freeGap: Free options are static files or account-locked: PDF, Excel and Illustrator downloads (bommestudio.com/free-tech-pack-template, collectivestudioltd.com/resources/tech-pack-template, aitechpacks.com/blog/fashion-tech-pack-template, techpacktemplates.com) that do not grade sizes or export a filled pack; template.net/edit-online/518489/tech-pack is a generic editor with accounts and a Pro tier; sewport.com/tech-pack needs an account; Techpacker is a 7 day trial with no free plan (techpacker.com/pricing). Gap: no free, no-signup tool on page one builds a structured tech pack (spec table with grading, BOM, sketch, callouts) and exports a PDF. Risk: small brands need few packs a year, so a monthly price may convert poorly.

serp.notes: tech pack template (WebSearch standard): 10 of 10 weak (template.net, university and spam mirrors, slideshare, techpacks.squarespace.com, makeitbritish.co.uk, payhip.com). Same term (WebSearch extended): 8 of 10 weak (techpacktemplates.com, collectivestudioltd.com, madeapt.com, tchpack.com, amylynnsdesign.com, fibr.online, studio.graphtick.com, fupstudio.gumroad.com; vendors skema3d.com and aitechpacks.com). tech pack (WebSearch standard): about 5 of 10 weak (fridaythread.substack.com twice, makeitbritish.co.uk, racklify.com, a producthunt collection; vendor blogs worldfashionexchange.com, gembah.com, portless.com). No Canva, Smartsheet, SafetyCulture or Jotform on page one. Weaker count 5 of 10. Firecrawl search was out of credits on 28 Nov, so the second source is WebSearch extended; Firecrawl recheck due after 22:14 UTC before the case is decided.

legal: Legal (Vikram) screen: clean. B2B apparel production documents, no regulated category, nothing aimed at children, no brand copying, no compliance or legal promises

evidence.claim: UrbanDistro on Etsy sells a Fashion Tech Pack Template Bundle (USD 8.22 on sale from 16.43); the shop shows 10.5k sales and the listing 73 reviews.

FIBRTechpacks on Etsy sells an editable Excel tech pack template (cover, measurements for 9 sizes, costing, colourways, cut sheet) for about USD 11.82; the shop shows 764 sales and the listing 32 ratings averaging 4.5.
Make it British sells a Tech Pack Bundle of InDesign, Google Sheets and PDF templates with a checklist and examples for GBP 39 plus VAT, one-time.
Techpacker sells its Techpack Builder plan at USD 35 per user per month billed yearly (USD 420 a year), with only a 7 day free trial and no free plan.

AI Tech Packs sells a Starter plan at USD 50 a month (about 3 tech packs) up to USD 150 a month unlimited, and also one-time credits at USD 1 each with a standard tech pack costing 20 credits, so a per-pack price of about USD 20 is already on the market.

Fiverr freelancers are paid per garment to make tech packs: one gig sells a simple 1 garment tech pack at USD 150 (seller rated 5.0 from 12 reviews), another a 2 item pack with BOM and size chart at USD 60 (seller 117 reviews).
People search how to make a tech pack about 260 times a month in the US, alongside tech pack template 2,400, tech pack example 590 and garment tech pack 1,000 (seodata.dev).

lead.name: Mahi
lead.trait: Prices with proof from the market.

evidenceAgainst: Etsy templates sell at USD 8 to 17 one-time, so many buyers expect a one-off price far below Rs 500 a month (https://www.etsy.com/listing/1698863971).
AI Tech Packs already offers no-subscription per-pack credits at about USD 20 a pack, which suggests buyers who need few packs a year resist monthly plans (https://aitechpacks.com/pricing).

Fiverr designers at USD 60 to 150 a garment compete for the brand that would rather outsource than fill a form (https://fiverr.com/oti_will/create-a-professional-clothing-tech-pack-for-manufacturing).
killReason: No-go: case scores 18 of 35 against a bar of 24 (competitionGap 2, speedToRevenue 2, recurringRevenue 2). Spot checked 28 Nov 2026: Techpacker has no free plan, a 7 day trial and USD 35 a month billed yearly for collaboration features (techpacker.com/pricing); AI Tech Packs sells one-time credits at USD 1 each, 20 credits a standard pack, so about USD 20 a pack with no subscription (aitechpacks.com/pricing). Search buyers pay USD 8 to 12 once for a reusable template (etsy.com/listing/1698863971), far below Rs 500 a month; CLO-SET and template.net already give the free version; no payment rail; likely 90 day revenue about USD 24. A per-pack pivot clears the floor only at 4 or more packs a year and meets a USD 20 incumbent with no new buyer evidence, so no pivot.
